setting: a container port seen from high above: a long pale-grey concrete dock road with white lane arrows and pedestrian stripes, lined on both sides by stacked shipping containers in teal, yellow and grey, under a hazy white sky

subjects.desc: a blue-uniformed soldier with a dark helmet and rifle, jogging in tight formation with identical squadmates
a red-uniformed enemy infantryman with a dark helmet and rifle, standing or charging in ranks

sound: hundreds of boots on concrete, shouted orders, distant harbour cranes
